title: Rollers why
description: A charcoal band with a faint diagonal sawtooth texture: an olive chip, a very large white heading with an orange second line and a short lede beside it, then numbered reasons two to a row, each under a soft white hairline with a big orange number (01–06), a white title and a short paragraph. Lines draw in, words rise, reasons fade up in pairs.
notes: dark in both modes: it uses the theme's .dark palette on itself
